column1: # V-009 (i-f): QEMU 10.1.0's float sweep, HASHED. One row per (op, rounding mode, form):
# FNV-1a-64 of the 2,104 result encodings (each as 8 little-endian octets, singles
# zero-extended) and FNV-1a-64 of the 2,104 fflags values (one octet each), in the case
# order of v009e_fp_inputs.tsv. form `dyn`: the rm field is DYN and frm holds the mode
# (probe_fp.S); form `static`: the rm field holds the mode and frm holds (mode + 2) % 5
# (probe_fp_static.S; only ops with an rm field). Generated by
# tools/v009-fp-probe/regenerate.sh, which also rebuilds the per-case results a failing
# test reads to NAME the case (V009_FP_RESULTS=<its output dir>).
